enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Holy III: On Hit: 3 to 12 Good damage. Good-aligned creatures are immune to this effect.Penalty: If equipped by a Evil user, they receive 1 Negative Level for as long as this item is equipped.
Solar III: On Hit: 3 to 12 Light Damage.
Impact: Passive: The base critical threat range of this weapon is doubled. This does not stack with Improved Critical feat. Vorpal Strikes by this weapon also bypass all Fortification.
Reinforced Fists: This item surrounds your fists with kinetic energy. Your unarmed damage is boosted by one half die.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
